observations: Photo 0 shows a used (tokumbo) car engine, removed from a vehicle, sitting on a truck bed.
Engine has visible wiring harness, intake manifold, pulley/belt system, and some bolts with surface corrosion/oil grime typical of a used unit.
No engine code, manufacturer logo, or model plate is legible anywhere on the block or manifold.
Bottom of image has an overlay 'CAMON 40' with camera settings (23mm f/1.8 1/100s ISO65) - this is phone camera metadata, likely the photographer's phone model, not the engine or car model.
A watermark 'NWANONSOBLESS' is visible, likely the seller's shop/brand name, not a product identifier.

claims.evidence: No import documents, foreign plate stamp, or shipping marks visible in photo 0.
No written warranty document, receipt, or shop signage shown; a guarantee claim cannot be confirmed from a photo.

risks.risk: Which vehicle make/model/engine code this fits is unknown, and this is the single biggest driver of price for a used engine.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the engine code/stamp (usually on the block near the bellhousing or on a sticker) or a clear seller statement of the exact car model it was pulled from, cross-checked against engine shape.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all, since engine value varies enormously by fitment

risks.risk: Mechanical condition unknown (compression, oil consumption, knocking, timing chain wear) — a used engine photo alone cannot show if it runs well.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running/idling with sound, plus a compression test reading if available.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed running / worst case non-functional

risks.risk: Completeness of parts (sensors, injectors, turbo if applicable, wiring harness) may be missing or swapped from photo.
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos including full harness, intake, exhaust side, and oil pan.
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare block, missing accessories

risks.risk: Tokumbo origin and mileage/history claim cannot be verified, affecting expected remaining lifespan.
risks.proof: Photo of import documents, auction sheet, or chassis/engine number paperwork.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified used import, no history discount applied

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/stamp or plate to identify exact model and vehicle fitment.
Video of the engine running/idling with audible sound.
Additional photos from other angles showing full completeness (exhaust side, oil pan, sensors).
Any import/auction documentation supporting the 'direct tokumbo' claim.
response.reason: The engine's exact model/fitment cannot be read from the photo, and this is the primary factor determining its price range, so even a worst-case price is not yet possible without a legible engine code or confirmed vehicle match.
